blocking_defect: s6 final pixels differ from the approved preview
classification: Deterministic exact-frame extraction error in proof comparison, not a changed product or creative failure.

finding.cause: stage_sample_problems converts scheduled integer frame872 to872/30 seconds; preflight_animatic.frame formats that seek to four decimals (29.0667), above the exact frame872 presentation time29.0666666667. FFmpeg then returns frame873 at29.1s. Scene6 begins29.08s, so the mistaken next-frame decode crosses the scene cut.
finding.conclusion: The exact requested index passes under the existing comparison threshold; the current rounded seek matches the adjacent frame exactly. Preserve the original failed comparator result as technical evidence.

recommended_minimal_fix.scope: Exact integer-frame extraction for native final proof comparison only. Preserve film, board, renderer, narration, captions, native proof/sample bytes and existing thresholds.
recommended_minimal_fix.implementation: Use the scheduled integer frame index directly in an exact frame helper (FFmpeg select=eq(n,index), scaled PNG decode), rather than converting to rounded input-seek time. Wire stage_sample_problems to that helper; retain generic time-based extraction behavior for unrelated callers. Reject invalid/noninteger/negative or unavailable frame indices.
recommended_minimal_fix.verification: Add a decoded encoded-video regression at a30fps scene boundary where index/30 rounds upward and current seek returns the next scene. Assert exact index selection returns intended pixels. Keep wrong/missing-frame, genuinely changed final pixel, occupancy/motion and evidence hash rejection tests. Rerun the actual24sample native comparison read-only using unchanged film/proof.
recommended_minimal_fix.prohibited_shortcuts: No nearest-frame search, threshold increase, selected-sample skip, manual pass, frame schedule rewrite, renderer change or rerender is needed to correct this measured extraction fault.

limitations: Read-only exact decoding of the failing sample and adjacent frame. Parent independently measures all24samples. No edit, ledger reservation, render, provider call or shipment certification.
